notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces by tapping it.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
